run_get_energies: run the script to extract final potential energies from VASP relaxation trajectories in parallel
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a ZIP archive to a target directory using extract_file
process_vasp_trajectories: process VASP trajectory files to extract final potential energy values using process_func
refactor_extract_file: refactor extract_file to support extracting multiple files from a ZIP archive at once
review_process_func: review process_func to add error handling for missing or corrupted vasprun.xml files
